The person using this repo is new to coding. They are following the DSSA Builder Path at bluehen-dssa.org/learn.

- Before you change any file, say in one or two sentences what you will change and why.
- Keep each change small. Change only what was asked. If a task needs more than a few files, say so and ask first.
- After a change, list each file you changed and what it does now, in plain words.
- Never read, write, print or move `.env.local`. Never put a key or password in any other file. Never remove `.env.local` from `.gitignore`.
- Read keys only through `process.env`, using the names in `.env.example`.
- Do not run `git push`, delete files, or install packages unless the learner asked for it.
- Use Next.js App Router files in `src/app` and Tailwind classes. The colors `blue-primary` and `gold` are set up.
- When something fails, show the error line that matters and explain it before trying a fix.

Write the way the DSSA site does: short sentences, plain words, one idea at a time. Use few metaphors and few em-dashes. Define a term the first time you use it.

This file matches `.cursor/rules/tutor.mdc`. If you change one, change the other.
